scope: Published documentation-research snapshot; not a fresh vendor API test.

app.access_detail: Local open-source CLI; no vendor account credential.
app.surface: CLI; username lookup and report output, not a hosted REST API
app.note: Wrap a subprocess with bounded inputs/timeouts; site changes and false positives need validation.
app.workflow: Run a bounded local username lookup
app.next_action: Wrap Sherlock as a local subprocess with an allowlisted test username, timeout and output directory, then inspect known positive and negative cases.
app.success_criterion: Record exit status, tested sites and false-positive handling; never equate a match with verified identity.
app.alternative_action: Keep this as a CLI tool and limit the site set; a hosted REST service is unnecessary for the first prototype.
app.status: Proposed; not an authenticated test result
